decks.notes: This deck utilizes a combo involving Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also includes Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disrupt opponents, as well as Wrenn and Six for additional value and consistency. The deck aims to be proactive and disruptive, using a mix of counter magic and removal to control the game while setting up its game-winning combo. The inclusion of cards like Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds additional versatility and utility to the deck.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to quickly summon powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide control and protection against opponents' spells, while Wrenn and Six and Leyline Binding offer additional utility and protection. The deck also includes cards like Transmogrify and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional combo potential. The mana base is designed to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the combo. Overall, the deck aims to creatively assemble its combo pieces to overwhelm and outmaneuver opponents.

This deck focuses on aggressively dealing direct damage to the opponent's life total using low-cost burn spells and creatures with haste. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero by efficiently using burn spells like Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, and Lightning Bolt, while creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear apply early pressure. The deck utilizes lands like Inspiring Vantage, Sunbaked Canyon, and Fiery Islet to ensure consistent access to red mana and additional cards when needed. The inclusion of cards like Searing Blaze, Boros Charm, and Skullcrack provides flexibility and disruption against the opponent's strategies.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy utilizing Merfolk creatures. By utilizing cards like Lord of Atlantis, Master of the Pearl Trident, and Merfolk Trickster, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure. Cards like Aether Vial and Cavern of Souls help to efficiently cast Merfolk creatures, while cards like Dismember and Force of Negation provide removal and protection. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Mistcaller and Tide Shaper to control the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to overwhelm opponents with powerful, low-cost creatures and disruptive spells. Utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into Crashing Footfalls and other impactful spells, this deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain tempo throughout the game. With a mix of aggressive creatures and versatile spells, this deck can adapt to different matchups and disrupt opponents' strategies while building a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on using Glimpse of Tomorrow to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield quickly. By cascading into either Risen Reef or Shardless Agent, the deck can generate card advantage and mana ramp to further accelerate its game plan. The end goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures like Chancellor of the Forge and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while controlling the board with cards like Endurance and Fury. The deck also includes a few utility lands like Khalni Garden and Cavern of Souls to support its strategy.

The central focus of this deck is to aggressively deal direct damage to the opponent as quickly and efficiently as possible. By utilizing low-cost burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt, along with efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. Additionally, cards like Boros Charm, Skullcrack, and Roiling Vortex help bypass any potential defenses put up by the opponent, ensuring a fast and lethal victory. The mana base is optimized for consistent and fast play, with fetch lands helping to thin out the deck and ensure the right colors of mana are available when needed.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive gameplay using efficient threats and disruption spells. By combining powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain momentum throughout the game. Counterspell and Spell Pierce provide protection and disruption against opposing spells, while cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble help maintain card advantage and smooth out draws. The mana base is streamlined to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana for casting spells efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to use cards like Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to cheat out powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six. The deck also uses Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Lightning Axe, Thoughtseize, and Inquisition of Kozilek are included to deal with threats and control the board. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ziatora's Proving Ground allows for additional utility and flexibility in gameplay.

The deck revolves around utilizing the powerful combo of Underworld Breach with spells like Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder to generate infinite loops and overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to control the game and protect the combo. The inclusion of Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional aggressive threats and card advantage. The mana base is streamlined to support the combo pieces and ensure consistent access to all the necessary colors of mana.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply early pressure on the opponent. It also disrupts the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and uses removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board. Additionally, it leverages cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to generate value and maintain card advantage. Finally, it utilizes powerful enchantments like Blood Moon and Feign Death to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory through fast, efficient aggression.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty or combo pieces like Persist. Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler provide utility and control elements to protect the combo, while Dwarven Mine helps ramp into the spells needed to assemble the combo. Leyline Binding and Prismari Command provide additional removal and disruption, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can help dig for combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond.

This aggressive Jund deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan. Utilizing powerful cards like Tarmogoyf, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Abrupt Decay. Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize help to disrupt the opponent's hand while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and utility. The deck also includes versatile options like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Kolaghan's Command to adapt to different matchups.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction, Expressive Iteration, and Archmage's Charm. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure the opponent and close out the game. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and threats, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection spells such as Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain momentum. Additionally, removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt help control the board. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful colorless threats like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. It also utilizes artifacts like Expedition Map and Chromatic Sphere to search for lands and fix mana. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Engineered Explosives allows for additional control and removal options, while Golos, Tireless Pilgrim provides versatility and card advantage. The deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents with its powerful threats and mana advantage.
